mapper.select: SELECT uri, image_base64 AS "imageBase64", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.images WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY uri
SELECT uri, image_base64 AS "imageBase64", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.images WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY uri
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.images (game_id, uri, image_base64, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{uri}, #{imageBase64}, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, uri) DO UPDATE SET image_base64 = EXCLUDED.image_base64, updated_at = NOW()
